metric: DREAM Olfaction Prediction Challenge Subchallenge 1 mean Z-score

published_group_scores.note: The text gives one individual-level Pearson correlation per score group and does not name the model behind them. Dividing them by the Subchallenge 1 null model standard deviations gives a mean Z-score of 34.2, which matches the winner's 34.18, so they most likely describe GuanLab. This is an inference, not a stated fact. The z_scores are derived here, not published.
